name: cmdb_graph_auth
label: Configuration Management -- graph_auth Table
description: Configure the graph_auth table, which belongs to the configuration management module. It can be used for related query scenarios such as configuration management reporting.

fields.name: graph_id
fields.description: The graph association ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Configure the auth_type field in the graph_auth table in the CMDB, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_uuid
fields.description: Auth association UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the graph_id, auth_type, auth_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
